item.title: Swedish government plans stricter deportation rules for convicted foreigners

item.description: Second-hand markets and vintage clothing have become a major trend in Denmark in recent years. Here’s where to thrift and what to look out for.

item.title: International graduate faces rejection at SDU and must leave Denmark despite prior acceptance and English-language bachelor’s
item.description: The Bangladeshi graduate is leaving Denmark after SDU cited English proficiency requirements to reject his application, even though he had been accepted months earlier. He holds a Danish bachelor’s degree taught in English, and the legislation may have been applied retroactively.

item.title: Municipal staff get pay hike and third child sick day
item.description: A new three-year collective agreement has been reached for 500,000 Danish municipal employees, including teachers, pedagogues, and nurses.
